text: Good afternoon.
translation: 下午好。

text: My name's Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school extended hours childcare service.
translation: 我是卡特夫人，我负责学校的课前课后延时托管服务。

text: I hope you've had a chance to have a good look around the school and talk to staff and pupils.
translation: 希望你们有机会好好参观一下学校，并与教职员工和学生交谈。

text: I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school, and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don't, I'll go through the main details now.
translation: 我知道你们中很多人有兴趣在孩子入学后使用我们的托管服务，也许你们已经对它有所了解，但对于那些不了解的人，我现在来讲一下主要细节。

text: We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven both before and after school.
translation: 我们为四到十一岁的儿童提供课前和课后托管服务。
highlights: from the ages of four to eleven

text: I know that many parents who work find this service invaluable.
translation: 我知道很多上班的家长觉得这项服务非常宝贵。

text: You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be extremely well cared for.
translation: 你可以放心地把孩子交给我们，知道他们会得到极好的照顾。

text: We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many attending at any one session.
translation: 我们获准为最多70名儿童提供托管服务，尽管任何一次托管中很少有这么多孩子参加。

text: I think we generally expect around 50-60 children for the afternoon sessions and about half that number for the breakfast sessions.
translation: 我想我们通常预计下午场大约有50到60名儿童，而早餐场大约是这个数字的一半。

text: Although we currently do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day.
translation: 虽然我们目前确实有70名儿童注册，但并非所有这些孩子每天都来。

text: It's ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we've come a long way during that time.
translation: 自从我们开始提供延长时段服务以来已经十年了，在这段时间里我们取得了很大进展。

text: When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending regularly.
translation: 我们刚开业时，只有大约20个孩子定期来。

text: We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money.
translation: 我们尽量把费用保持在尽可能低的水平，我们认为我们提供了非常划算的服务。
highlights: keep our costs as low as we can

text: For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it's £7.20.
translation: 下午的时段从3点30分到下午6点，费用是7.20英镑。

text: But if you prefer, you can pay for one hour only, which costs £3.50, or two hours which costs £5.70.
translation: 但如果您愿意，也可以只付一小时的费用，是3.50英镑，或者两小时是5.70英镑。

text: The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks.
translation: 托儿费用包括食物和零食。

text: They'll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school.
translation: 他们早上会得到早餐，下午一放学就会得到一份健康的零食。
highlights: as soon as they finish school

text: At 5 p.m.
translation: 下午5点。

text: children are given something more substantial, such as pasta or a casserole.
translation: 孩子们会得到一些更实在的东西，比如意大利面或炖菜。

text: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a suitable alternative.
translation: 请告知我们您孩子可能有的任何过敏情况，我们会确保给他们提供合适的替代品。

text: As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m.
translation: 你可能知道，托儿服务在整个学校假期期间运行，从上午8点开始。

text: to 6 p.m.
translation: 到下午6点。

text: We offer a really varied and exciting programme to keep the children entertained - we don't want them to feel as if they are still at school!
translation: 我们提供非常丰富多样又令人兴奋的活动项目，让孩子们玩得开心——我们不想让他们觉得自己还在学校！

text: It will also feel different because they'll get the chance to make new friends with children from other schools - spaces are available for them because a lot of our term-time children don't always attend during the holiday.
translation: 这也会感觉不一样，因为他们将有机会与其他学校的孩子交新朋友——名额是有的，因为我们很多学期期间的孩子在假期并不总是来。

text: In the past, parents have asked if children over the age of 11 are allowed to come with their younger brothers and sisters - but I'm afraid we're unable to do this because of the type of insurance we have.
translation: 过去，家长们问过11岁以上的孩子是否可以和他们的弟弟妹妹一起来——但恐怕由于我们所拥有的保险类型，我们无法这样做。

text: So now let me tell you about some of the activities that your child can do during the after- school sessions.
translation: 那么现在让我告诉你们一些你们的孩子在课后时段可以做的活动。

text: As well as being able to use the playground equipment, computers and /12 /12 the library, there is usually at least one 'special' activity that children can do each day.
translation: 除了能够使用游乐场设备、电脑和图书馆之外，通常每天至少还有一项孩子们可以做的“特别”活动。

text: For example, Spanish.
translation: 例如，西班牙语。

text: We have a specialist teacher coming in every Thursday to give a basic introduction to the language through games and songs.
translation: 我们有一位专业老师每周四来，通过游戏和歌曲对这门语言做基础入门介绍。

text: She does two one for the over 8s and one for the younger children.
translation: 她上两节课——一节给8岁以上的孩子，一节给更小的孩子。

text: This is the only activity which we have to make an extra charge for - but it's well worth it.
translation: 这是我们唯一需要额外收费的活动——但非常值得。

text: Once a week the children have the opportunity to do some music.
translation: 孩子们每周有一次机会接触音乐。

text: We're very lucky that one of our staff is a member of a folk band.
translation: 我们很幸运，我们的一位员工是民乐队的成员。
highlights: a member of a folk band

text: On Mondays, she teaches singing and percussion to groups of children.
translation: 每周一，她教几组孩子唱歌和打击乐。

text: We do rely on parental support for this, so if any of you sing or play an instrument and would be prepared to help out at these sessions, we'd be delighted.
translation: 我们确实依赖家长的支持，所以如果你们中有人会唱歌或演奏乐器，并且愿意在这些活动中帮忙，我们会非常高兴。

text: Painting continues to be one of the most popular activities.
translation: 绘画仍然是最受欢迎的活动之一。
highlights: one of the most popular activities

text: To begin with we weren't keen on offering this because of the extra mess involved, but children kept asking if they could do some art and so we finally gave in.
translation: 一开始我们不太愿意提供这个，因为会弄得很乱，但孩子们一直问能不能上美术课，所以我们最终让步了。

text: Art is great for helping the children to relax after working hard at school all day.
translation: 美术非常有助于孩子们在学校辛苦学习一整天后放松下来。

text: Yoga is something that we've been meaning to introduce for some time but haven't been able to find anyone available to teach it - until now that is.
translation: 瑜伽是我们想推出一段时间的活动，但一直找不到可以教的人——直到现在。

text: So we'll see how this goes.
translation: 那么我们就看看这个进行得怎么样吧。

text: Hopefully, children will benefit in all sorts of ways from this.
translation: 希望孩子们能从中在各方面受益。

text: Cooking is another popular activity.
translation: 烹饪是另一项受欢迎的活动。

text: They make a different sort of cake, or pizza or bread each week.
translation: 他们每周会做不同种类的蛋糕、披萨或面包。

text: Although the younger children love doing it, we found that the mess was just too much, so we've decided to restrict this to the over 8s, as they are better able to clean up after themselves.
translation: 虽然年幼的孩子很喜欢做这件事，但我们发现弄得实在太乱了，所以我们决定只让 8 岁以上的孩子参加，因为他们更能够自己收拾干净。
highlights: the mess was just too much
better able to clean up after themselves
